info.name: CommerceX API
info.description:
Postman collection for the CommerceX e-commerce backend.

## Base URL
- Default: `http://localhost:3000/api/v1` (change the `baseUrl` collection variable if needed)

## Authentication
This API uses an **httpOnly cookie** named `accessToken`, NOT a Bearer token.

1. Call **POST /auth/login** (or `/auth/register`).
2. The login response sets the `accessToken` cookie. The collection automatically captures the token into the `accessToken` variable.
3. A collection-level pre-request script adds the `Cookie: accessToken=...` header to every request automatically, so protected routes "just work".

## How the auto-variables work
- Creating a **Category** saves its `_id` into `categoryId`.
- Creating a **Brand** saves its `_id` into `brandId`.
- Creating a **Product** saves its `id` into `productId`, and its first variant's `id` into `variantId`.
- Creating an **Inventory** saves its `id` into `inventoryId`.
- Creating an **Address** saves its `id` into `addressId`.
- Creating a **User** (admin) saves its `id` into `userId`.

The **Cart** endpoints all act on the **currently logged-in user's** cart (one cart per user) and use `{{variantId}}` for their items. **Checkout** turns that cart into an order using `{{addressId}}`.

This means you can run the requests in order and they will chain together automatically.

## Suggested workflow
1. POST /auth/register (customer)
2. POST /auth/login
3. Create an admin user via **POST /users/create** with `"role": "ADMIN"`, then login with that admin account to access admin-only routes.
4. Create a category, then a brand, then a product.

## Notes
- Password rules: 4 to 10 characters.
- Phone number must use E.164 format, e.g. `+919876543210`.
- The `/forgot-password` flow prints the reset token / OTP to the **server console** in development. Copy it from there into the `/reset-password` body.
- Deletes are **soft deletes** (they set `isActive: false`), so the record still exists but is hidden from public listing.

request.description: Public. Returns `{ success, message }` to confirm the server is running.

Public. Creates a new **CUSTOMER** account.

Body fields:
- `name` (3-50 chars, required)
- `email` (valid email, required, unique)
- `password` (4-10 chars, required)
- `phone` (E.164 format like +919876543210, optional, unique)

Note: registration does NOT set a cookie. Use **POST /auth/login** afterwards to get the `accessToken` cookie.

Public. Logs in and sets the `accessToken` **httpOnly cookie** (24h expiry).

A test script automatically reads the `accessToken` from the `Set-Cookie` response header and stores it in the collection variable `accessToken`. Every protected request after this will include it automatically.

exec: console.log('Login succeeded but no accessToken cookie found in Set-Cookie');

request.description: Requires login. Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user. Run **POST /auth/login** first.
Public. Clears the `accessToken` cookie. No request body needed.

Requires login. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the logged-in user's phone (stored server-side, 5 min expiry).

Requirements: the user must have a `phone` saved and `isPhoneVerified` must be false. In development the OTP is printed to the server console.

Requires login. Verifies the phone OTP sent by **POST /auth/send-phone-otp**.

Body:
- `otp`: exactly 6 digits (required)

Public.

Body:
- `identifier`: an email **or** E.164 phone number.

If email: creates a 15-min password-reset token (printed to the server console in development).
If phone: sends a 6-digit OTP (also printed to console). Always returns a generic message for security.

Public. Verifies the password reset OTP sent to email or phone and returns a reset token.

Body:
- `identifier`: email or phone number used in forgot-password
- `otp`: the 6-digit OTP from the server console

Automatically stores the resetToken into the collection variable on success.

Public. Completes the password reset.

Body:
- `identifier`: same email/phone used in **forgot-password**.
- `token`: the reset token (email flow) or the OTP (phone flow) from the server console.
- `password` and `confirmPassword`: 4-10 chars, must match.

Clears the existing login cookie on success.

Requires **ADMIN** login.

Body fields:
- `name` (3-50 chars, required)
- `email` (valid, required, unique)
- `password` (4-10 chars, required)
- `role`: `CUSTOMER` | `ADMIN` | `SELLER` (required)
- `phone` (E.164 format, optional, unique)

A test script saves the created user's `id` into the `userId` collection variable.

Tip: create an ADMIN here, then log in with it to unlock the admin routes.
Requires **ADMIN** login. Returns all users. No request body.

Requires **ADMIN** login. Fetches a single user.

Path param:
- `userId`: set automatically when you run **POST /users/create** (or set it manually).

Requires **ADMIN** login. Partially updates a user. At least one field is required.

Optional fields:
- `name`
- `email` (must not already exist)
- `role`
- `phone` (E.164 format; changing it resets `isPhoneVerified` to false)
- `isActive` (boolean)

Requires **ADMIN** login. **Soft deletes** the user by setting `isActive: false`.

Fails with 400 if the user is already inactive.
Requires login (any role). Updates profile fields for the logged in user.
Public. Returns all categories sorted alphabetically by name.

Public. Fetches a single category.

Path param:
- `categoryId`: set automatically when you run **POST Create Category** (or set it manually).

Requires **ADMIN** login.

Body fields:
- `name` (2-50 chars, required, must be unique)
- `description` (max 200 chars, optional)

The `slug` is generated automatically from the name.

A test script saves the created category's `_id` into the `categoryId` collection variable (used by the product endpoints).

Requires **ADMIN** login. Partially updates a category. At least one field is required.

Changing `name` also regenerates the slug and rejects names that already exist.

Requires **ADMIN** login. **Soft deletes** the category (sets `isActive: false`).

Fails with 400 if already inactive.

Changing `name` also regenerates the slug and rejects names that already exist.

request.description:
Public. Returns only **active** products, newest first.

Both query params are optional. Remove them (or leave them empty) to list every active product.

Public. Fetches a single **active** product.

Path param:
- `productId`: set automatically when you run **POST Create Product** (or set it manually).

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. Creates a product.

Important: create a **category** and a **brand** first — the body references `{{categoryId}}` and `{{brandId}}`, which are auto-filled from the Create Category / Create Brand requests.

Body fields:
- `name` (3-100 chars, required)
- `description` (max 1000 chars, optional)
- `categoryId` (required, must exist)
- `brandId` (required, must exist)
- `images` (array of URL strings, optional)
- `variants` (at least 1, required):
  - `name` (required)
  - `sku` (required, **must be unique** — case-insensitive)
  - `price` (must be > 0)
  - `attributes` (object of strings, optional, e.g. color/storage)
  - `images` (optional)

The seller is taken from the logged-in user automatically. A test script saves the product's `id` into the `productId` collection variable.

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. Partially updates a product. At least one field is required.

- A **SELLER** can only update their **own** products (403 otherwise). An **ADMIN** can update anything.
- Changing `name` regenerates the slug.
- Replacing `variants` re-checks for duplicate SKUs.
- When replacing variants, every variant must include `name`, `sku`, and `price` (they are required by the variant schema).

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. **Soft deletes** the product (sets `isActive: false`).

- A **SELLER** can only delete their **own** products (403 otherwise).
- Fails with 400 if the product is already inactive.

query.description: Optional. Filter by product. Auto-filled after you create a product.
Optional. Filter by SKU (converted to uppercase for matching).
Optional. Set to true to show only records where available (stock - reserved) <= lowStockThreshold.

request.description:
Public. Returns **active** inventory records, newest first.

Query params (all optional):
- `productId`: filter by product
- `sku`: filter by SKU
- `lowStock`: set to `true` to show only low-stock records

Each record includes a computed `available` (stock - reserved) and an `isLowStock` flag.

Public. Fetches a single **active** inventory record.

Path param:
- `inventoryId`: set automatically when you run **POST Create Inventory** (or set it manually).

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login.

Important: create a **product** first — the body uses `{{productId}}` (auto-filled) and `{{variantId}}` (auto-filled with the first variant's id from the Create Product response).

Body fields:
- `productId` (required, must exist)
- `variantId` (required, must belong to the product)
- `stock` (whole number >= 0, optional, defaults to 0)
- `lowStockThreshold` (whole number >= 0, optional, defaults to 5)

The `sku` is copied automatically from the product variant.

Fails with 409 if an inventory record already exists for this variant.

A test script saves the inventory's `id` into the `inventoryId` collection variable.

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. Partially updates an inventory record. At least one field is required.

Optional fields:
- `stock` (whole number >= 0)
- `lowStockThreshold` (whole number >= 0)

Note: unlike the read endpoints, this does NOT filter by `isActive`, so it can update soft-deleted records too.

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. Increases or decreases the physical `stock` count by a quantity.

Body fields:
- `quantity` (whole number > 0, required)
- `operation`: `"increase"` or `"decrease"` (required)

Decreasing fails with 409 if there isn't enough stock (the check is atomic, so stock can never go negative).

Tip: try `"operation": "decrease"` with a quantity larger than the current stock to see the 409.

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. Puts stock **on hold** for pending orders by incrementing `reserved` (the physical `stock` is unchanged).

Body:
- `items` (at least 1, required): array of `{ variantId, quantity }`

Each item only succeeds if `stock - reserved >= quantity`. The whole request is a **transaction**: if ANY variant lacks stock, the entire batch is rolled back and returns 409.

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. Takes stock **off hold** (e.g. an order was cancelled) by decrementing `reserved`.

Body:
- `items` (at least 1, required): array of `{ variantId, quantity }`

Each item only succeeds if `reserved >= quantity`. The whole request is a **transaction**: if ANY variant has insufficient reserved stock, the entire batch is rolled back and returns 409.

Requires **ADMIN** or **SELLER** login. **Soft deletes** the inventory record (sets `isActive: false`).

Fails with 400 if already inactive.

Requires login (any role). Returns the logged-in user's **cart summary**: list of items plus `totalItems` (sum of quantities) and `subtotal`.

If the user has no cart yet, an empty one is created automatically.

Each item shows the product (id/name/slug), variant id, SKU, snapshot name/price/image, quantity, and computed `lineTotal`.

Requires login (any role). Adds a product variant to the user's cart.

Body fields:
- `variantId` (required, must be an **active** variant of an active product)
- `quantity` (whole number > 0, required)

If the variant is already in the cart, its quantity is **incremented**.

The item is rejected (409) if the requested quantity exceeds what's sellable (`stock - reserved` from the Inventory module). Name/SKU/price/image are snapshotted from the variant at add time.

Uses `{{variantId}}`, which is auto-filled with the first variant of the last product you created.

Requires login (any role). Sets the **absolute** quantity for an item already in the cart.

Body:
- `quantity` (whole number > 0, required)

Path param:
- `variantId`: the variant to update (auto-filled from Create Product).

Returns 404 if the variant isn't in the cart, and 409 if the quantity exceeds sellable stock.

Requires login (any role). Removes an item completely from the cart.

Path param:
- `variantId`: the variant to remove (auto-filled from Create Product).

Returns 404 if the variant isn't in the cart.

Requires login (any role). Saves an address for the logged-in user.

Body fields:
- `type`: `SHIPPING` or `BILLING` (optional, defaults to `SHIPPING`)
- `fullName`, `phone`, `line1`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `pincode` (required)
- `line2` (optional)
- `country` defaults to `India` if omitted.

A test script saves the created address's `id` into the `addressId` collection variable (used by checkout and the other address requests).

Requires login (any role). Returns the logged-in user's **active** addresses, newest first.

Optional query param:
- `type`: filter by `SHIPPING` or `BILLING`.

Only the user's own addresses are returned.

Requires login (any role). Fetches a single address.

Path param:
- `addressId`: set automatically when you run **POST Create Address** (or set it manually).

Returns 404 if the address doesn't exist, is inactive, or belongs to another user.

Requires login (any role). Partially updates one of the user's own addresses. At least one field is required.

All body fields from Create are optional here. Returns 404 if the address isn't the user's own.

Requires login (any role). **Soft deletes** one of the user's own addresses (sets `isActive: false`).

Returns 404 if the address isn't the user's own, and 400 if already inactive.

Requires login (any role). Converts the user's cart into an **order** and returns the **order summary**.

Body fields:
- `shippingAddressId` (required, must be one of the user's active addresses)
- `billingAddressId` (optional — if omitted, the shipping address is used)

What happens (all inside one **transaction**):
1. Stock for every cart line is **reserved** via the Inventory module (409 if any variant lacks stock).
2. An **Order** is created with `status: PENDING` and snapshots of the items + both addresses.
3. The user's cart is **cleared**.

If any step fails, everything rolls back. Requires addresses + a non-empty cart.
Requires login. Initiates a payment checkout on Razorpay for items currently in the cart and returns the razorpayOrderId.
Requires login. Verifies the cryptographic payment signature returned by Razorpay.
Public callback endpoint for Razorpay webhooks. Validates signature and completes order process.
Requires login. Initiates a payment checkout on Razorpay for a direct purchase of specific variants (bypassing the cart) and returns the razorpayOrderId.
Requires login (ADMIN or SELLER). Uploads a base64 encoded product image to ImageKit.
Requires login. Retrieves the order history for the logged-in customer.
